figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the whole chapter is one function y(x,t): the map shows the single spine Parts 1-11 hang off
figures.data: the eleven-part structure of the notes
figures.read: everything in this chapter is a slope, an area, or a boundary condition applied to y(x,t)
figures.source: Read this first: the four foundational truths

figures.title: The sign rule for direction
figures.why: direction is read off the sign inside the argument, not off the algebra
figures.data: the four argument forms kx ± ωt and the cases they produce
figures.read: opposite signs travel +x; same signs travel -x

figures.title: The two waveform envelopes
figures.why: the peak-valued slope triangle vs the RMS energy slope is the mechanical key
figures.data: kinematic slope (∂y/∂x -> v_p, peak values) vs energy slope (RMS)
figures.read: the kinematic slope gives velocities peak-to-peak; the energy slope flattens to RMS - mixing them is the trap

figures.title: Energy density is in phase with the wave
figures.why: energy crests sit at the zero-crossings, not the amplitude peaks, contradicting oscillator intuition
figures.data: u_k = u_p = (1/2) μ ω² A² cos²θ sampled at θ in {0, π/4, π/2, 3π/4, π}
figures.read: kinetic and potential energy densities peak together at the zero-crossings and vanish at the crests

figures.title: Superposition begets standing waves
figures.why: a standing wave is two travelling waves, not a new phenomenon
figures.read: equal amplitude/frequency/wavelength, opposite directions make a standing wave that traps energy

figures.title: Triage - travelling or standing first?
figures.why: the first question routes the entire solution
figures.data: the first rule of §8.1 - argument form decides travelling vs standing
figures.read: the argument form names the species first; direction, velocity, and energy follow from the right branch
